i_chiton.lore.common: Rides out every wave glued flat to its rock, then creeps off to graze the moment the tide goes out.

i_european_fire_salamander.lore.legendary: Has lived under the same mossy log for fifty years, and the forest path was bent round it so nobody would disturb it.

i_mud_turtle.lore.rare: Pokes just its nose above the muddy water to breathe, so the ducks keep paddling into a nostril.

x_chrysalis.lore.rare: Shimmers with tiny gold dots in the morning light, as if it's been sprinkled with glitter for a special occasion.

i_nematode.lore.legendary: Has been found living everywhere on Earth, from mountain tops to the deepest sea, and nobody has ever once noticed it arrive.
